Mohammed Azeezulla
AI/ML Engineer
+1 (872) 330-2122 | mohammedazeezulla6996@gmail.com | LinkedIn | Portfolio | GitHub | Chicago, IL

Summary
AI/ML Engineer with around 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML/AI systems across finance and healthcare data domains, including LLMs, risk analytics, credit modeling, fraud detection, and portfolio intelligence. Proficient in prompt engineering, fine-tuning transformer architectures, ML pipelines, and automated evaluation frameworks to improve model performance and reliability. Strong expertise in Python development, MLOps, and scalable production-grade deployments using Spark, Airflow, AWS SageMaker, and Docker-based microservices.

Skills
Machine Learning & Statistical Modeling: Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Feature Engineering, Classical ML Algorithms, Anomaly Detection Models, Model Evaluation, SHAP Explainability
Programming Languages: Python, SQL, Bash
Deep Learning & GenAI Tools: TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Autoencoders, LSTM Networks, Attention Mechanisms, Transformers, Generative Models, Multimodal Models, Vector Embeddings, Token-Level Reasoning
MLOps, Deployment & Model Lifecycle: MLflow, Airflow, AWS SageMaker, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD for ML Systems, Model Monitoring, Experiment Tracking, Automated Scoring Pipelines
Large Language Models & GenAI Frameworks: OpenAI Models, Claude, LlamaIndex, Gemini, LangChain, CrewAI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM Inspectors, Prompt Engineering, Multi-Agent AI Systems, Embedding-Based Retrieval
AI Testing, Evaluation & Automation: Playwright, PyTest, spaCy, Hugging Face, Agentic AI Testing, Structured Extraction Pipelines, Representation Alignment, Semantic Scoring, Vector Stores, Automated Evaluation Frameworks
Big Data & Real-Time Processing: Apache Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, HDFS, Redis, Elasticsearch, Real-Time Streaming Pipelines, Event-Driven Processing
Cloud Platforms, Databases & Visualization: AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, SageMaker, SQS), Azure Cognitive Services, PostgreSQL, SQL Databases, Power BI, Tableau, Compliance Dashboards, JSON-Based Data Mapping

Experience

State Street USA
AI/ML Engineer  Oct 2025 – Present
– Architected a GenAI investment intelligence solution leveraging LLMs and OpenAI large language models with practical knowledge of LLMs applied through retrieval-augmented reasoning, reducing manual portfolio risk analysis effort by 45% for investment teams.
– Constructed robust ML pipelines and a semantic retrieval layer handling large-scale unstructured or semi-structured data with LangChain and vector-based search to unify trades, benchmarks, and regulations, improving natural language portfolio insight accuracy by 38%.
– Fine-tuned finance-aware transformer models using PyTorch and Hugging Face architectures to strengthen investment terminology understanding, decreasing incorrect financial explanations by 30% during volatile market review cycles.
– Operationalized scalable model inference through containerized deployment of production-quality ML codebases and governed MLOps orchestration with observability tooling, optimizing inference performance, enabling secure fintech AI usage and increasing analytics platform adoption by 28%.
– Synthesized pricing signals, liquidity metrics, and performance drivers into RAG-based investment narratives, improving portfolio explanation clarity by 40% and reducing reporting preparation effort by 35%.

TekAnthem USA
Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Remote)  Jun 2025 – Sep 2025
– Engineered an Agentic AI testing workflow with production code and strong Python development skills using CrewAI, NLP, and Python to replace unreliable manual validation, refine LLM prompt behavior, automate multi-agent evaluations, and elevate testing efficiency by nearly 60%.
– Devised a structured information extraction pipeline using representation learning and Azure Cognitive Services to handle inconsistent UI layouts, design JSON-based output mapping, generate reusable backend objects, and achieve nearly 90% accuracy.
– Coordinated Claude-driven automation with Playwright and PyTest to strengthen fragile test flows, introduce prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented prompts, embed redundancy logic, and improve test-recovery performance by around 70%.
– Constructed multimodal evaluation dashboards with OpenAI Models, LangChain, and embedding-based scoring to overcome inconsistent model reviews, formalize validation workflows, standardize AI safety checks, and increase stakeholder adoption to roughly 90%.
– Advanced the AI QA lifecycle and QA processes by integrating Gemini, vector stores, and LLM-based inspectors, operating with comfort in fast-paced, ambiguous environments to fix inconsistent monitoring, enforce unified scoring metrics, automate research validation, and accelerate deployment cycles by nearly 40%.

Streebo Inc India
Machine Learning Engineer  Sep 2021 – Dec 2023
– Engineered a financial risk intelligence pipeline applying entity resolution and feature extraction to unify borrower histories, bureau files, salary documents, and payment streams, and optimized processing using Spark, SQL, credit-bureau APIs, AML/KYC modules, and OCR parsers, boosting credit-risk readiness by over 42% and improving stability assessment through refined Power BI insights.
– Formulated advanced credit-default and fraud-likelihood models leveraging familiarity with modern ML/NLP frameworks including LightGBM, Scikit-Learn, and TensorFlow while applying data normalization and aligning model architecture with loan decision workflows and orchestrated retraining, bias checks, and MLflow versioning which elevated scoring precision by over 31% and supported loan officers with SHAP-driven financial explainability.
– Integrated Kafka streaming with Spark, Redis, AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, SQS) services, and fraud-scoring/AML monitoring feeds to detect transaction velocity shifts, merchant anomalies, and geo-behavior outliers, and refined Autoencoder-based anomaly logic across compliance checkpoints, boosting fraud-capture consistency by over 37% and improving analyst case reviews in Tableau.
– Directed Airflow-based scoring cycles and AWS SageMaker deployments by standardizing batch and streaming inference paths with de-ID workflows for risk and fraud modules and optimized orchestration and alert delivery using Elasticsearch insights which reduced manual intervention for financial risk units by over 40% through stable automation and rapid scoring turnaround.
– Executed unified microservice deployments across Docker and Kubernetes while embedding HIPAA-aligned regulatory checkpoints into finance workflows and synthesized model interpretability, account-level traceability, and transaction-level audit trails which improved analytic reliability by over 29% and positioned the platform to support secure lending operations and scalable payment monitoring.

Bachelors in Computer Science and Engineering  Jun 2023

Projects

Multi-Stage LLM Application with RL Fine-Tuning and RAG
– Engineered a multi-stage GenAI application with recommendation systems by applying fine-tuning to a Qwen model for task-specific reasoning, applying GRPO training with a five-level evaluation framework built on Unsloth, and validating output quality through structured scoring logic.
– Integrated and deployed a real-time RAG system by connecting search APIs sourced from Wikipedia and Google SERP, implementing LlamaIndex and spaCy for contextual retrieval and entity parsing, optimizing inference with vLLM, and delivering a React and TypeScript frontend with a FastAPI backend deployed on Vercel and Render.

Skin Disease Analyzer with Enhancement in VGG19 Algorithm
– Developed a Flask-based medical-image analysis system using healthcare data from a curated 10k dermatology dataset, integrating condition-specific recommendation APIs and delivering scalable, real-time skin-disease classification for 50+ users with consistent diagnostic support.
– Fine-tuned VGG19 with optimized preprocessing, augmentation, and selective layer unfreezing, achieving 94% accuracy while reducing overfitting, and validated the end-to-end pipeline through safety checks, logging, and evaluation workflows presented at IEEE 2023.

Symptoms to Solution
– Designed a symptom-to-disease prediction engine processing clinical data from a 10K+ healthcare dataset and 132 severity-weighted features, applying structured data-modeling techniques to enhance interpretability and strengthen clinical decision-support accuracy.
– Optimized ML models including Decision Trees, Random Forest, XGBoost, AdaBoost, and SVM using cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning on structured EMRs data, deploying a normalized SVM that achieved 78% accuracy with improved runtime efficiency for scalable prediction workflows.
